title: PCR Preparation for Gel Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure pipette mount sides
steps.instruction: Enter the appropriate mount side for the P20 single‑channel GEN2 pipette and the P300 multi‑channel pipette in the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Arrange deck as per map
steps.instruction: Place all labware on the deck positions indicated in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette; consult the support articles for additional tips.
